title: form
description: A curated group of CDEs used to collect data (NIH CDE Repository Guide: 'a curated group of multiple CDEs… may represent a known instrument, assessment, survey, questionnaire, or case report form (CRF)'). This is the data-collection instrument — NLM's non-bundle Form and NINDS's CRF both land here. A form ASSEMBLES elements: its members are CDEs (and, when a source records it, bundles), in question order; it does NOT re-vet recommendation tiers — the tier is a property of the vetted unit (a bundle, or a CDE's disease classification), not of the form. Membership is a direct member -> form PART_OF relationship. The form's own taxonomy placement (which disease/domain it is filed under) lives in `form_classification` (one row per form x steward x context), mirroring `cde_classification`. NOTE: an NLM Form flagged isBundle=true is NOT a form — it is an indivisible `bundle` (see the bundle model).

form_key.description: The form's identity. For NLM forms this is 'nlm:<tinyId>' (globally unique); for a direct-steward source (e.g. NINDS) it is the steward's own form id (CRF id, e.g. 'F1123'). The human title lives in `form_name`.

form_name.description: Human-readable form title (the form's primary designation, e.g. 'Adverse Event Tracking Log').

instructions.description: Instructions for completing the form, when the source provides them.

steward_org.description: The steward org that owns the form (the authoritative owner, e.g. NINDS). Same concept as cde.steward_org; distinct from a classification edge's steward_org (the classifying authority in form_classification).

steward_code.description: The steward's OWN form identifier (e.g. NINDS CRF 'F1123'), when the source records it. Cross-source form identity: NLM re-hosts a steward's form under form_key 'nlm:<tinyId>' but carries the steward code here, and a direct-steward source (e.g. ninds-sync) keys the same form by this code — so integrate merges them on COALESCE(steward_code, form_key), letting the higher-priority source supersede the other instead of both surviving as duplicate forms. Null when the form has no steward-assigned code.

member_cde_keys.description: Member cde_keys in question order. An ordering hint for display; membership itself is the cde -> form PART_OF edges.

nlm_view_url.description: Canonical NLM CDE Repository form view page.

registration_status.description: NLM/ISO-11179 administered-item lifecycle state of the form.

nih_endorsed.description: NIH-Endorsed governance flag (NLM `nihEndorsed`). Same flag as cde.nih_endorsed / bundle.nih_endorsed.

copyright_status.description: Upstream copyright / redistribution status (NLM `copyrightStatus`, e.g. 'Public domain, free to use'). Same concept as cde.copyright_status.

num_questions.description: Number of questions (CDEs) on the form — distinguishes tight instruments from large CRFs.

source_version.description: The upstream source's own version string, captured verbatim (e.g. NLM/caDSR '3.1'). Same concept as cde.source_version.
